integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D anime style, cinematic, surrealistic, a medium shot establishes a dark, infinite void filled with floating, glowing green node wires. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the center where the Male Character — messy black hair, heavy dark circles under his eyes, light stubble on his chin and cheeks, a loose-fitting plain black hoodie, dark blue denim jeans, and white sneakers — stands floating. His expression is terrified, illuminated by the eerie green glow. Suddenly, the green wires turn blood red, instantly wrapping around his wrists and torso like thick iron chains. An exhausted, hoarse young male voice, speaking at a frantic, desperate rate (S1), says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 千万别学ComfyUI，千万别学ComfyUI！碰了这个软件，你就完了！</d> while the Male Character's lips remain completely closed. The Male Character struggles violently against the red digital chains as the space around him distorts and glitches with chromatic aberration.

overall_soundscape: A low, ominous humming of digital energy fills the endless void. The sharp rustling of his hoodie fabric and heavy denim is heard as he struggles. A harsh, electric crackle sparks loudly when the green wires abruptly turn red.

non_diegetic_music: A tense, ominous ambient track with a slow heartbeat rhythm plays, building up to a jarring, distorted synthesizer swell at the end of the segment.
由于这里加了二次采样放大的技术，所以，分辨率的数值要在0.9以下，最大是0.9。因为我默认的放大倍率是1.5倍。0.9的数值对应的是1080*1920的分辨率。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D anime style, cinematic, surrealistic, a tight close-up matching the exact composition of the previous segment's final frame — the Male Character's face in absolute horror, half-covered by crawling red error boxes. The camera holds a static shot for two seconds. During this buffer period, a bead of anime-style oversized sweat rolls down his cheek, and his jaw clenches tightly. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to an extreme wide shot showing the Male Character standing atop a massive, impossibly complex, glowing geometric city made of connected workflow nodes against a night sky. The camera pans out at fast speed to reveal its majestic scale. The exhausted voice (S1) shouts with breaking vocal cords in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 辛辛苦苦搭建成型的工作流，一次模型更新，全部成了垃圾！</d> while his lips remain completely closed. A massive pixelated lightning bolt strikes the structure from above. In an instant, the entire glowing node city shatters and transmutes into thousands of gray, mundane plastic trash bags that rain down heavily around him, burying him waist-deep in literal garbage.

overall_soundscape: A massive, earth-shattering digital thunderclap rips through the air, followed immediately by the physical, heavy thuds and crinkling of plastic trash bags falling in enormous quantities. 

non_diegetic_music: The chaotic industrial track crescendos into a deafening bass drop at the lightning strike, simulating a catastrophic system crash, then instantly transitions into a mournful, solitary, out-of-tune cello melody playing a pathetic tune over the falling garbage.

## 段2（对应成片 00:10–00:20）— 短暂的虚幻神明
& 10 & 
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D anime style, cinematic, surrealistic, a medium shot matching the exact composition of the previous segment's final frame — the Male Character struggling violently against the red digital chains in the dark void, the space glitching around him. The camera holds a static shot for two seconds. During this buffer period, his struggle slows, his chest rising and falling heavily as he catches his breath, his eyes darting downward. No dialogue, no camera motion. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a low-angle wide shot. The dark void instantly transforms into a bright, ethereal cloudscape bathed in warm, divine light. The red chains shatter into glowing golden butterflies. The Male Character floats peacefully, holding a glowing golden orb that projects a holographic, hyper-detailed anime girl above his hands. The camera revolves around him in an arc shot at slow speed. The voiceover (S1), now shifting to a tone of delirious, ironic arrogance, says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 刚上手跑出高清美女的时候，你真的以为，自己无所不能。</d> while his lips remain completely closed. The Male Character smiles a tired but euphoric smile, completely hypnotized by the hologram.

overall_soundscape: The harsh electric crackle from the previous segment shatters like glass, instantly replaced by the soft, ethereal chime of digital magic. The glowing orb hums with a warm, pure frequency. The Male Character's heavy breathing softens into silence.

non_diegetic_music: The ominous track abruptly shifts at 00:02.000 to a soaring, falsely triumphant orchestral swell with angelic choir synths, mimicking a brief, over-the-top moment of divine power and delusion.

===

## 段3（对应成片 00:20–00:30）— 报错地狱的侵蚀
& 10 & 
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D anime style, cinematic, surrealistic, a low-angle wide shot matching the exact composition of the previous segment's final frame — the Male Character floating in the bright cloudscape, smiling deliriously while holding the golden orb projecting the anime girl. The camera holds a static shot for two seconds. During this buffer period, his smile slowly twitches and droops, his eyes blinking sluggishly as a shadow falls over his face. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a tight close-up of his face. The divine golden light abruptly flashes violent red. The voiceover (S1), returning to a tone of pure despair and exhaustion, says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 然而，接下来是无尽的折磨。排查报错，更新插件，</d> while his lips remain completely closed. The camera tilts down with small amplitude as the ethereal background melts into a claustrophobic sea of glaring red, rectangular UI "Error" boxes. The error boxes physically multiply like a virus, crawling up his neck and sinking into his hoodie and skin like leeches. His eyes widen in absolute horror, his pupils shrinking to pinpricks.

overall_soundscape: The soft chime of the orb distorts into a jarring, ear-piercing Windows error beep. Frantic digital crunching and clicking sounds layer aggressively as the red boxes multiply, mixed with the Male Character's sudden, sharp gasps of panic.

non_diegetic_music: The angelic choir from the previous segment glitches and cuts out violently at 00:02.000, replaced by a chaotic, industrial noise track featuring harsh metallic scraping and irregular, stressful high-frequency synth stabs.

===
